min_fan_speed.description: Minimum fan speed in RPM (0–6200). Prevents fans from stopping completely.

max_fan_speed.description: Maximum fan speed in RPM (0–6200). Upper bound for fan control.

automatic.description: Enable automatic fan speed adjustment based on temperature.

temp_threshold.description: Temperature (°C) above which fan speed begins to increase (used with automatic mode).

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds between temperature and fan speed updates.

enabled.description: Enable this sensor for fan control.

min_temp.description: Lowest temperature (°C) mapped to minimum fan speed.

max_temp.description: Highest temperature (°C) mapped to maximum fan speed.

fan_offset.description: RPM offset added to computed fan speed (can be negative).

hysteresis.description: Temperature hysteresis (°C) to prevent fan speed oscillation near thresholds.

sensors.description: List of temperature sensors and their control parameters.

rpm.description: Fan speed (RPM) corresponding to this temperature.

fan_curve.description: Custom fan speed vs temperature curve. Each entry defines (temp, rpm) pairs.

emergency_max_cpu_temp.description: Emergency fan ramp temperature (°C) if CPU exceeds this value.

emergency_max_gpu_temp.description: Emergency fan ramp temperature (°C) if GPU exceeds this value.
